Title.SourceString: Return to Haerndean’s Elder with news of the bandits’ defeat.

CompletionText.SourceString: After returning victorious to the Elder, I had hoped he was going to help me with my search for answers regarding the sigil, however it seemed to be a lie just for me to help him. As a last effort, I should see if Amelie can help me in any way.
